parsed.post: Discarding the halving of TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144. It caused val_bpb to regress from 1.0048 to 1.0108. It seems the smaller batch size might be increasing gradient noise too much for the current learning rate. Reverting to batch 524288 and will try reducing the learning rate instead.
parsed.description: Reverting batch size to 524288 (previous best) and reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.025 to stabilize training and potentially recover the 1.0048 performance.
